sections.title: The letter эм
paragraphs: The letter is named (эм) /ɛm/. Its main sound is heard in the word (мама) /ˈma.mə/, which means mom. This letter makes two sounds.

sections.title: How to say эм
paragraphs: Close both lips firmly and let air flow through your nose with voice. For the second sound, smile slightly and lift your tongue body. Touch your throat to feel your voice shake.

sections.title: Spelling rules for эм
paragraphs: The letter makes its hard sound before non-palatal vowels, before consonants, or at the end of a word, as in (дом) /dom/. It makes its palatalized sound before soft vowels or the soft sign, as in (мир) /mʲir/. A palatalized consonant is said with the middle of the tongue raised toward the roof of the mouth. The soft sign shows this change in (семь) /sʲemʲ/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not insert a y sound before the vowel in words like music. Simply raise your tongue toward the roof while closing your lips.
